nuggets.text: Keelon Russell racked up 342 total yards in his first start, second only to Bryce Young's 343 for an Alabama QB debut.
Keelon Russell is the Crimson Tide's first teenage starting quarterback since Jalen Hurts in 2016.
Ryan Coleman-Williams added his mother's surname, Coleman, this season and swapped No. 2 for his high school No. 1.
The Crimson Tide have appeared in 297 straight AP polls, the longest active streak in college football.
Kalen DeBoer is 41-2 in September as a college head coach, and his teams average 45.6 points that month.
Kalen DeBoer won three NAIA national titles at Sioux Falls, where he went 67-3 as head coach.
The Crimson Tide became the Elephants in 1930 after a writer reported a fan bellowing, 'Hold your horses, the elephants are coming!'
Saturday is SEC Nation's 60th show at an Alabama game, the most of any SEC school.
The Crimson Tide have won their last 10 SEC openers and are unbeaten in their last 19 played on the road.
Saban Field at Bryant-Denny Stadium has the best all-time home winning percentage in the FBS: .845 since 1929.
